description: Retrieval evaluation gold set for the Enterprise RAG Agent. Each query pairs a question with the chunk IDs (from data/eval/all_chunks.json) that a human annotator judged relevant, grounded in the actual indexed documents. Relevant IDs were verified against the real chunk contents before annotation.

queries.query: What are the main risk factors discussed by N-able?
queries.note: N-able ITEM 1A Risk Factors summary (p22) plus a specific risk factor discussion (p47).

queries.query: How does NPS earn royalties from Sensipar?
queries.note: NPS royalty payments on Sensipar/PTH from Kyowa Hakko Kirin and Amgen (p50, p60).

queries.query: What was N-able total revenue in 2024?
queries.note: N-able reports total revenue of $116.5 million for Q4 2024 (p59).

queries.query: What cybersecurity framework does N-able maintain?
queries.note: N-able ITEM 1C Cybersecurity describes the framework including COSO and ISO 27001 (p54).

queries.query: What licensing and collaboration revenue did NPS report?
queries.note: NPS reports revenues from product sales, royalties and milestones from licensees (p49).

queries.query: What are NPS principal products Gattex and Revestive?
queries.note: NPS revenue relates to product sales of Gattex launched in US in Feb 2013 and royalties; Revestive approved in EU (p49).

queries.query: What does Item 1A say about risk factors overview?
queries.note: N-able ITEM 1A Risk Factors Summary of Risk Factors (p22).

queries.query: How does N-able define ARR and customer count?
queries.note: N-able reports 2,349 customers with ARR over $50,000 as of Dec 31 2024 (p60).

queries.query: What market risk does N-able disclose regarding foreign currency?
queries.note: N-able ITEM 7A market risk: changes in foreign currency exchange rates (p75).

queries.query: What dividend policy does N-able disclose?
queries.note: N-able states it does not intend to pay dividends on common stock (p51).

queries.query: What intellectual property risks does NPS mention?
queries.note: NPS risk factor about collaborators licensing IP to research, develop or commercialize products (p37).

queries.query: What liquidity sources does NPS rely on?
queries.note: NPS principal sources of liquidity are cash, cash equivalents and marketable investment securities (p55).

queries.query: What accounting firm audits N-able financial statements?
queries.note: Report of Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm for N-able (p83).

queries.query: What stock-based compensation expense did N-able report?
queries.note: N-able reports stock-based compensation expense and employee count of 1,773 as of Dec 31 2024 (p61).

queries.query: What is NPS royalty agreement with Kyowa Hakko Kirin?
queries.note: NPS entered into agreement with Kyowa Hakko Kirin in 1995, royalty advance with 9% discount, Amgen resumes paying royalties (p50).

queries.query: What acquisition did N-able complete for Adlumin?
queries.note: N-able completed acquisition of Adlumin, Inc. in connection with Form 8-K filing (p57).

queries.query: What contingent consideration did N-able record?
queries.note: N-able recognized $3.7 million gain on contingent consideration liability; fair value $3.7 million as of Dec 31 2024 (p122).

queries.query: What are NPS collaborators and licensees?
queries.note: NPS has royalty-based agreements with Amgen, Janssen, GlaxoSmithKline and Kyowa Hakko Kirin (p11).

queries.query: What are NPS clinical trial phases for PTH?
queries.note: NPS describes Phase 2 clinical studies for PTH in limited patient population (p16).

queries.query: What restructuring costs did N-able incur?
queries.note: N-able discusses non-GAAP operating margin, restructuring costs and spin-off costs (p68).
